### shlang/array_article.html
Array
Book: 1C language

An array of the built-in language stores values by index and grows as they are added.

### shlang/struct_for.html
For Each
Book: 1C language

Syntax:
For Each <Variable name 1> In <Variable name 2> Do
// Operators
[Break;]
[Continue;]
EndDo;
Description:
The For Each operator traverses a collection.

### shquery/union_section.html
UNION
Book: query language

Combines the results of two query descriptions. UNION [ALL] <query description>
